title: Upgrade attestation: cross-variant fingerprinting & golden-query suite
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: build a reproducible attestation layer that certifies a candidate runtime/model variant for LTS and rolling upgrades by comparing behavior across a curated set of deterministic "golden queries" and probabilistic fingerprint vectors. This ticket scopes the golden-query suite, cross-variant fingerprint generation, and a small deterministic harness to catch tokenization, KV-cache warmup, and routing-fallback regressions before any LTS or critical rollout. Rationale: our existing signal surface (latency/time-series plus smoke checks) misses subtle cross-variant semantic drift caused by tokenization/quantization paths or KV priming differences. A focused attestation layer reduces false-positive rollbacks and surfaces regressions that are customer-visible (reranking, deterministic prompts, short-seq interactive flows).
acceptance_criteria: Create a golden-query corpus (~120 queries) covering: short interactive prompts, embeddings parity checks, rerank anchors, and long-sequence continuation edge cases
Implement cross-variant fingerprint function that outputs stable hash vectors for model responses (with normalization rules documented)
Run harness that executes golden queries against current LTS, candidate runtime build, and a lightweight fallback variant; produce a delta report (token-level diffs and semantic-similarity scores)
Add automated gating: if >X% of queries exceed semantic-drift threshold OR any deterministic-failures (tokenization mismatch, truncated KV warmup) then mark candidate as failed for staged rollout
Publish an initial runbook and dashboard tiles in Console illustrating per-query signal, top-5 divergent queries, and confidence bands
Attach reproducible CI job on release pipeline that runs the attestation within the preflight window and uploads artifacts to Drive and the runbook link
runbook_steps: Checkout candidate build and LTS baseline; ensure same model weights and tokenizer versions are used
Spin ephemeral harness cluster (cpu-proxy + minimal gpu runtime) via release-harness blueprint
Prime KV cache with canonical session traces for warmup-sensitive queries
Execute golden-query suite (serial then randomized batches) and collect token traces, logits, and final normalized outputs
Compute fingerprint vectors and delta scores; generate HTML report with diffs and similarity metrics
Evaluate gate: if deterministic_fails > 0 OR semantic_drift_score > threshold => FAIL and capture debug bundle
If PASS, tag candidate as attested and trigger staged LTS rollforward with soft-fail thresholds configured
comments: 2026-02-26 - Maya Patel: Initial spike complete. Built 40/120 golden queries from customer incident corpus and internal eval sets. Early failures primarily tokenization edge cases and one rerank anchor mismatch.

2026-03-01 - Jonas Klein: Implemented prototype fingerprint hashing using normalized whitespace + lemmatized similarity. Proof-of-concept run against runtime-1.18 shows stable vectors across minor kernel swaps.

2026-03-04 - Design review (Helen O'Rourke): Console tile mockups uploaded: https://drive.redwood/release-validation/golden-query-tiles. UX asks for per-query 'blame' waterfall and quick link to logs.
2026-03-06 - Infra note (PR #1245): Added KV priming job and deterministic RNG seed to harness. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1245
2026-03-09 - PM feedback (Ravi Singh): Add explicit customer-impact mapping for each golden query (e.g., 'search-autocomplete', 'billing-invoice-parser') so SOC can prioritize fixes when flagged.
2026-03-10 - Jonas Klein: Updated acceptance gates and threshold draft in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/display/RELEASE/Upgrade+Attestation+Runbook. Ready for engineering review next week.
notes: Implementation considerations: fingerprinting must ignore non-deterministic timestamps and request-id tokens. Semantic similarity should use both embedding cosine and token-level edit distance to catch both paraphrase drift and truncation/regression. Keep per-query golden artifacts small and shareable (JSONL with input, expected normalized output).
